Engage Motivate Support Challenge
Welcome to Marlborough Primary School
Marlborough Primary is a popular, three-form community school situated in Isleworth in the London Borough of Hounslow. The school was rebuilt in 1997 to create a spacious, modern and attractive learning environment.
In addition to the 630 mainstream education places, we have a Nursery which caters for 78 children. We also have a thriving Community Centre which provides additional services for pre-school children, parents/carers and members of the local community.
Our intake of pupils reflects a culturally rich and diverse community and we have a strong reputation for offering an inclusive and broad and balanced curriculum for all our learners.
Why Join Us?
Year Groups
What’s Happening at Marlborough Primary School
What Our Community Say...
“I can’t praise the school highly enough. The teachers motivate the children to excel in everything they put their hands to – everyone is friendly, polite and welcoming. It is a joy to be part of this lovely school.”
“The clubs and trips are great – we have been on some really interesting visits and we have lots of visitors who come and run exciting workshops.”
“There is a positive, inclusive climate for learning in the school. Staff enjoy working at Marlborough. Pupils experience success, irrespective of their abilities or different starting points.”
Reception Open Days – September 2027
Is your child due to start Reception in September 2027?
We warmly invite prospective parents and carers to visit Marlborough Primary School and see our Reception classrooms in action. Come and meet our staff, explore our school and find out more about starting school with us.
For children born between 1st September 2022 and 31st August 2023.
Places must be booked in advance.

pageCache.pageTitle: Marlborough Primary School - Vision and Values
pageCache.text:
Vision and Values
Our vision is to create a thriving, inclusive school community where every child is engaged, motivated, supported, and challenged to achieve their very best.
Our School Vision
Engage: Actively participate in learning experiences
Motivate: Respond positively to the learning process
Support: Flourish within our inclusive environment
Challenge: Understand that learning requires effort
Our School Values
We foster positive relationships promoting mutual respect and core values of kindness, resilience, integrity and curiosity.
“Pupils thrive in this caring and supportive school. They live out the school values of kindness, integrity, curiosity and resilience every day.”
Ofsted - November 2024

Welcome
Marlborough Primary is a popular three form community school situated in Isleworth within the London Borough of Hounslow.
The school was originally opened on 29th June 1936 and rebuilt in 1997 to create a spacious, modern and attractive learning environment.
Our intake of pupils reflects a culturally rich and diverse community and we have a strong reputation for offering an inclusive and broad and balanced curriculum for all our learners.
At Marlborough our vision is to engage, motivate, support and challenge learners to achieve their personal best and become successful life-long learners.
Our curriculum is designed to empower learners to take responsibility, have a growth mindset and strive to be their personal best.
We understand the importance of strong relationships with all stakeholders, built on our core values of kindness, resilience, integrity, and curiosity.
Everyone is welcome at Marlborough Primary School. We are committed to working together with you to ensure your child is successful and happy. We look forward to being part of your child’s journey, supporting them every step of the way.

pageCache.text:
Personal, Social, Health and Economic (PSHE) including RSHE
Following our consultation with parents/carers we have now finalised our policy and teaching programme to ensure our PSHE and RSHE provision is appropriate for our pupils based on their age and physical and emotional maturity. We will be using a high quality published scheme called Jigsaw.
PSHE Intent, Implementation & Impact Report

Relationships, Sex and Health Education (RSHE)
The Department for Education has announced changes to Relationships, Sex and Health Education (RSHE).
These changes will come into effect before the end of the Summer Term 2021 and all schools are required to comply.
Please click here to access the guidance for parents/carers from the Department for Education.
RSHE Curriculum Map
PSHE & RSHE Resources
Please click here to read the school's Personal, Social and Health Education and Relationships and Sex Education Policy.
PSHE Material Access Request December 2023

Partnerships
At Marlborough we value working in collaboration.
We work alongside neighbouring primary schools and local high schools to support children in our community. Our partnership with our families is invaluable in contributing to our successes as a school.
We are looking to launch Parent Ambassadors across all phases in the term. If you would like to learn more about how you can support the school and join this group, please register your interest with the school office.

pageCache.pageTitle: Marlborough Primary School - Free Meal Schemes
pageCache.text:
Free School Meals, Food Vouchers, Breakfast Club & Holiday Support
We are committed to supporting families in Hounslow by providing clear information about the free meal schemes available. At our school, we want every child to be well-fed and ready to learn. National and local funding can support families to access a variety of free meal programs - at school, during holidays, and at home.
Free Meals Summary
Universal Free School Meals (UFSM)
All primary pupils (Reception –Year 2)
Automatically provided at school
Free School Meals (Mayor’s Scheme)
All London primary pupils (Year 3 –Year 6)
Automatically provided at school
Benefit- Related Free School Meals (FSM)
Families receiving certain benefits
Apply online via Hounslow Council
Holiday Food Vouchers
Children eligible for benefit-related FSM
Sent via email/text from the council
Holiday Activities & Food (HAF) Programme
Children eligible for benefit-related FSM
Booking links sent before holidays
Universal Free Breakfast
All pupils (Reception - Year 6)
Book sessions via Scopay
Universal Free School Meals (UFSM) & FSM (Mayor’s Scheme)
All children in Reception, Year 1, and Year 2 are entitled to a free school meal every day under the government’s Universal Free School Meals (UFSM) scheme. This ensures every child receives a healthy, nutritious lunch to support their learning and wellbeing.
Children in Year 3 to Year 6 attending a state-funded primary school in London are also entitled to a free hot meal every school day, funded by the Mayor of London, regardless of household income.
From September 2025, every child will automatically have a lunch booked for them eachday. This default option will be a vegetarian meal.
If you would prefer your child to have a different option – such as a meat meal, halalmeal, jacket potato, or if you plan to send a packed lunch from home – you will need tolog in to Scopay to update your child’s meal preferences.
Benefit -Related Free School Meals (FSM)
Even though all children now receive Universal Free School Meals (UFSM) & the FSM (Mayor's scheme), your family may still be entitled to additional support. If your child is eligible for benefit-related Free School Meals (FSM) based on certain criteria, the school will receive over £1,515 per year in extra government funding through the Pupil Premium.
This extra funding helps the school invest in:
Enrichment activities
Teacher training and development
Targeted support for children who need it most
Your child will also be eligible for:
Holiday Activities vouchers during school breaks
How to Check Eligibility for FSM & Apply
Your household may be eligible if you receive any of the following:
Apply for Free School Meals here
If you are unsure or need help, please contact the school office.
Income Support
Income-based Jobseeker’s Allowance
Income-related Employment and Support Allowance
Guaranteed Element of State Pension Credit
Holiday Activities and Food Programme (HAF)
If your child qualifies for benefit-related Free School Meals (FSM), they may also take part in the HAF programme, which offers free holiday clubs with meals.
✔️ Fun activities – sports, crafts, drama, and more ✔️ Healthy, hot lunch provided every day ✔️ Available during Easter, Summer, and Christmas breaks ✔️ Local venues across Hounslow
The entitlement for each eligible child:
You must be registered for benefit-related Free School Meals to receive your HAF vouchers, which are sent around 5 weeks before each holiday period.
4 days for 4 hours during Easter
16 days for 4 hours during Summer
4 days for 4 hours during Winter
HAF Hounslow Parents Padlet
Hounslow HAF - Information for parents
Choosing a HAF provision for your child
Food Vouchers (School Holidays)
For children eligible for benefit-related Free School Meals (FSM), Hounslow Council provides supermarket food vouchers during all school holidays (outside of HAF club dates).
Please make sure your contact details are up to date with the school, so you do not miss out.
Universal Free Breakfast Club – Open to All Pupils
To help children start the day well, we offer a free breakfast through the National School Breakfast Programme.
We are pleased to provide a Free Breakfast Club for all children from Reception to Year 6, held daily from 8:25am in our Community Centre. This club gives children a healthy breakfast and a calm, settled start to the day—helping them feel ready to learn
We have seen a fantastic response so far and look forward to welcoming even more children to our Breakfast Club.
Drop-off time: 8:25am – 8:40am
Need help?
Contact the school office by email on office@marlborough.hounslow.sch.uk or call on 020 8560 3978.
